action: The cost-sensitivity check completed. The momentum edge is evaluated against realistic transaction costs.
bottleneck: The candidate positive momentum evidence is short-horizon and mechanical; cost robustness remains decision-relevant.

candidate_tasks.bottleneck: The current evidence is strongest for one-day holding, so temporal robustness is still partly unresolved.
candidate_tasks.deliverable: A reproducible robustness artifact plus independent verification.
candidate_tasks.evidence_basis: Momentum is candidate positive evidence at a one-day hold and has already survived lookback and horizon robustness in magnitude.
candidate_tasks.objective: Test a fixed lookback-5 momentum signal with a predeclared small holding-period set using the existing walk-forward/null methodology.
candidate_tasks.out_of_scope: Do not tune the lookback or choose a holding period after inspecting results.
candidate_tasks.primary_question: Does the qualified momentum effect survive a small predeclared holding-period variation without becoming a single-point timing artifact?
candidate_tasks.scope: Use only the existing 10-asset universe and a fixed hold-period grid declared before execution.
candidate_tasks.stop_condition: Stop after the declared holding-period grid is complete and independently checked.
candidate_tasks.success_criterion: The holding-period sensitivity is classified and any positive finding is reproducible.
candidate_tasks.verification_requirement: Matched null, leakage review, independent recomputation, determinism, regression suite.

candidate_tasks.bottleneck: A candidate momentum effect may depend on market regime even after horizon robustness.
candidate_tasks.deliverable: A falsifiable regime-conditioned momentum result with independent verification.
candidate_tasks.evidence_basis: MA regime filters were previously falsified; whether the same class of conditioning helps the different momentum mechanism remains unresolved.
candidate_tasks.objective: Test one explicitly predeclared past-only volatility gate on lookback-5 momentum through the existing regime-stability and null framework.
candidate_tasks.out_of_scope: Do not search a threshold grid or optimize the gate after seeing results.
candidate_tasks.primary_question: Does a single past-only volatility gate create a predeclared robustness improvement for the qualified momentum effect?
candidate_tasks.scope: One volatility feature, one threshold rule declared before execution, existing 10-asset universe.
candidate_tasks.stop_condition: Stop after the one predeclared gate is evaluated and independently checked.
candidate_tasks.success_criterion: The gate either demonstrates a reproducible improvement in robustness or is falsified/unsupported.
candidate_tasks.verification_requirement: Leakage gate, matched null, regime-stability, independent recomputation, determinism.

next: The cost-robustness assessment is complete. The momentum evidence is qualified for advancement to the next research frontier: holding-period sensitivity testing (R-002) and regime-conditioning qualification (R-003).
